stage_transitions_note_required.name: stage_transitions_note_required
stage_transitions_note_required.value: "stage_transitions"."kind" NOT IN ('advance_with_exception', 'regress') OR ("stage_transitions"."note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("stage_transitions"."note") <> '')

students_scales_check.name: students_scales_check
students_scales_check.value:
("students"."skill_level" IS NULL OR "students"."skill_level" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND ("students"."english_writing" IS NULL OR "students"."english_writing" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND ("students"."english_speaking" IS NULL OR "students"."english_speaking" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

students_numbers_check.name: students_numbers_check
students_numbers_check.value:
("students"."hours_per_week" IS NULL OR "students"."hours_per_week" BETWEEN 0 AND 168)
        AND ("students"."income_goal_usd" IS NULL OR "students"."income_goal_usd" >= 0)

tasks_cancel_reason_check.name: tasks_cancel_reason_check
tasks_cancel_reason_check.value: "tasks"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("tasks"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("tasks"."cancel_reason") <> '')
